title: CARA: Cognitive Adaptive Recommendation Agent
abstract: arXiv:2608.16919v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent advances in large language models and agent-based recommendation frameworks have introduced new opportunities for more flexible and context-aware recommendation. However, existing methods still largely rely on semantic matching, end-to-end generation, or loosely structured agent workflows, without explicitly modeling how user preferences are processed and translated into final decisions. To address this limitation, we propose CARA, a cognitively inspired recommendation framework that formulates recommendation as a structured decision-making process. The core intuition of CARA is that user decisions are jointly shaped by two complementary mechanisms: intuitive affective preference and deliberate rational evaluation. translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.16919v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：近年来，大语言模型和基于代理的推荐框架的进展为更灵活和上下文感知的推荐带来了新的机遇。然而，现有方法在很大程度上仍依赖于语义匹配、端到端生成或松散结构的代理工作流，而未显式建模用户偏好如何处理并转化为最终决策。为解决这一局限性，我们提出了CARA，一种受认知启发的推荐框架，将推荐形式化为一个结构化的决策过程。CARA的核心直觉是，用户决策由两种互补机制共同塑造：直觉性情感偏好和深思熟虑的理性评估。因此，CARA将推荐组织为两个协调阶段：候选过滤，基于粗粒度偏好约束缩小搜索空间；以及双视角决策建模，后者进一步细化。
tldr: CARA通过模拟用户决策中的直觉情感与理性评估双机制，将推荐建模为结构化的两阶段决策过程，显著提升推荐的灵活性和上下文感知能力。
en_tdlr: CARA models recommendation as a structured two-stage decision process by simulating both intuitive affective and deliberate rational user mechanisms, enhancing flexibility and context-awareness in recommendations.
